# FormSection

> Lede 0.7.2's docs for FormSection, installed with it. Setup, and every item in the release: [README.md](README.md). Online: https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/form-section.md

A native `<fieldset>` and `<legend>` on a card surface, grouping and naming related fields.

## Install

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @lede/form-section @lede/text-field
```

The command needs Lede's registry in `components.json`, as [README.md](README.md#use-it-in-a-shadcn-project) shows. It also installs the items [`lede-theme`](lede-theme.md) and [`lede-utils`](lede-utils.md). It adds [`text-field`](https://lede.cloudcompute.com/reference/text-field.md) only because the example below imports it. The item's JSON, with each file's source, is https://lede.cloudcompute.com/r/v0.7.2/form-section.json.

## Import

```tsx
import { FormSection } from '@/components/lede/blocks/form-section';
```

## Files and exports

| Installs to | Import from | Exports |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `components/lede/blocks/form-section.tsx` | `@/components/lede/blocks/form-section` | `FormSection` (component), `FormSectionProps` (type) |

## Props

A native `<fieldset>` and `<legend>` on a card surface: related fields, grouped and named.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `legend` (required) | `React.ReactNode` |  | Names the group of fields; announced with each field inside. |
| `description` | `React.ReactNode` |  | One sentence on why these fields are asked for. |
| `children` (required) | `React.ReactNode` |  |  |
| `className` | `string` |  |  |

## Example

The smallest working use, from the docs site:

```tsx
import { FormSection } from '@/components/lede/blocks/form-section';
import { TextField } from '@/components/lede/text-field';

export function ProfileForm({ onSubmit }: { onSubmit: (data: FormData) => void }) {
  return (
    <form action={onSubmit}>
      <FormSection legend="About you" description="We use this on your profile.">
        <TextField label="Name" name="name" autoComplete="name" />
      </FormSection>
    </form>
  );
}
```

Docs: [Blocks](https://lede.cloudcompute.com/blocks.md).
